description_en: Retrieves the associations between Lindorm instances and tags
description_zh: 获取Lindorm实例和标签的绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to start the next query to return more results.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a query does not return all results, you can pass the NextToken value returned in the previous query to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
下一个查询开始Token，用来返回更多结果。

第一次查询不需要提供本参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的NextToken值以继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key.
You can specify multiple tag keys. For example, the Key in the first pair specifies the first tag key, and the Key in the second pair specifies the second tag key
fields.help_zh:
标签的键。
可以传入多个标签的键。例如：第一对中的Key表示传入第一个标签的键。第二对中的Key表示传入第二个标签的键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.
You can specify multiple tag values. For example, the Value in the first pair specifies the first tag value, and the Value in the second pair specifies the second tag value
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
可以传入多个标签的值。例如：第一对中的Value表示传入第一个标签的值。第二对中的Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to start the next query.

This parameter is returned if a query does not return all results. You can pass the value of this parameter in a subsequent query to continue the query
NextToken.description_zh:
下一个查询开始Token。

如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则会返回本参数，您可以后续查询中传入本参数返回的值以继续查询

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID, which is the instance ID

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. The value is fixed as ALIYUN::HITSDB::INSTANCE
ResourceType.description_zh: 资源类型。返回值固定为ALIYUN::HITSDB::INSTANCE
